data.rationale: Scenario-owned durable data observed in the canonical data directory.

budget.rationale: Durable data storage budget measured and governed on 2026-08-05; the byte ceiling prevents unbounded growth without permitting automatic deletion.

storage.rationale: Storage surfaces are declared from observed canonical scenario directories; external resource databases are not claimed by this scenario.

service.name: tunnel-manager
service.description: Central management, monitoring, and self-healing for the Cloudflare secure tunnel that provides remote access to all Vrooli scenarios.

ui.description: React UI (FIXED — Tunnel Manager is publicly exposed and must obey the fixed-UI-port contract it enforces on others)

secrets.label: Cloudflare API Token
secrets.description: API token used for remote Cloudflare tunnel operations.

secrets.label: Cloudflare Account ID
secrets.description: Cloudflare account identifier for remote tunnel operations.

secrets.label: Cloudflare Tunnel ID
secrets.description: Managed tunnel identifier for remote operations.

setup.description: Build API and UI assets declared by the manifest-driven lifecycle contract

steps.name: build-api
steps.run: cd api && GOWORK=off go mod download && GOWORK=off go build -o tunnel-manager-api .

steps.name: install-ui-deps
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm install --ignore-workspace || pnpm install --ignore-workspace); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

steps.name: build-ui
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm --ignore-workspace run build || pnpm --ignore-workspace run build); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

develop.description: Launch API and Vite dev server

steps.name: start-api
steps.description: Start Go API server in background

test.description: Execute phased test suite via test-genie

steps.name: check-temporal-models
steps.description: Verify formal flow artifacts via the flow-verifier scenario CLI

steps.name: run-tests
steps.description: Run all test phases via test-genie

hostTools.name: cloudflared
hostTools.reason: Core tunnel client managed by this scenario for all Cloudflare tunnel operations (health, recovery, ingress).

redis.description: Optional pub/sub for real-time UI updates; falls back to HTTP polling when absent.

structure-health.description: Assigns a free in-band fixed UI port (range→fixed) so a ranged scenario can be exposed as a scenario route, and releases it on revoke. Best-effort: already-fixed scenarios expose without it.

descriptors.label: Cloudflare Account ID
descriptors.description: Identifies the Cloudflare account that owns the tunnel. Resolved directly by this scenario through credential-authority-go, so it is never injected into the process environment.

descriptors.label: Cloudflare Tunnel ID
descriptors.description: Identifies the named tunnel this scenario manages.

descriptors.label: Cloudflare API Token
descriptors.description: Authorizes tunnel and DNS changes. Re-resolved per operation so a rotated token takes effect without restarting the scenario.
